name: covspace
description: DevSpace-style workspace-scoped MCP access to the Covspace OCI VM.

interface.shortDescription: Work with the remote Covspace workspace.
interface.longDescription: Open workspace-scoped repositories in /home/covspace/projects through a VM-resident Streamable HTTP MCP server over Tailscale, without changing DevSpace.
defaultPrompt: Open a Covspace repository as a workspace.
Inspect, edit, search, run commands, and use Git within the opened workspace.
